en.headline: Lee says five-year plan will keep Hong Kong’s capitalist system
en.dek: In a newspaper essay ahead of Wednesday’s Policy Address, the chief executive said the city’s first five-year plan would not change its legal or economic system.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said Hong Kong’s first five-year plan would uphold the city’s rule of law and capitalist system, the Basic Law and the “one country, two systems” principle. Writing in several newspapers on Monday under the title “Before the publication of Hong Kong’s first five-year plan”, he said the blueprint would also keep Hong Kong’s position as an international city and the free flow of capital, people, goods and data.

Lee will publish the plan on Wednesday, 16 September, and then deliver the 2026 Policy Address at the Legislative Council. He said the two documents were meant to be read together: the plan sets a longer-term direction, while the Policy Address is the annual report and the year’s policy priorities.

He said some residents had asked whether drawing up a five-year plan would change Hong Kong’s existing system. His answer, he wrote, was that the plan would not distort “one country, two systems”. He added that the government had completed the text in under a year after a two-month public consultation that received more than 17,000 submissions, about 80 per cent from individual residents, and more than 100 consultation sessions.

zh.headline: 李家超：五年規劃堅持香港法治及資本主義制度
zh.dek: 行政長官周一在報章撰文，指本周三公布的香港首個五年規劃會堅持法治、資本主義制度及「一國兩制」不變形、不走樣。
body: 行政長官李家超周一在多份報章以「寫在香港第一個五年規劃發表前」為題撰文，強調五年規劃會堅持香港的法治和資本主義制度，堅持貫徹《基本法》，堅持「一國兩制」不變形、不走樣，並維持香港國際城市定位，以及資金、人員、貨物和數據自由流動。
他將於周三（9月16日）公布《香港第一個五年規劃》，隨後在立法會發表《行政長官2026年施政報告》。李家超表示，兩份文件一脈相承，五年規劃繪製長遠藍圖與戰略方向，施政報告則是落實規劃的年度報告及當年施政重點。
李家超提到，有市民問制定五年規劃會否改變香港原有制度。他重申規劃不會改變現行制度。他指當局在不足一年內完成規劃文本，6月起展開為期兩個月的公眾諮詢，舉辦超過100場諮詢會，接獲逾1.7萬份意見書，當中約8成來自個別市民。
